method.workflow: Clean-room official-site reading from allowed repo docs, SRH crawler v0.3/v0.4 candidate JSON, embedded source evidence, and official srh-university.de pages only. v0.3 zero-output was treated as a crawler recall failure; v0.4 programme pages were treated as candidate recall, not truth.
limitations: No LLM v0.1 answer file was opened or compared.
SRH is a university group with many programmes; this v0.2 file reflects the 12 official programme URLs surfaced by the allowed v0.4 crawler candidate, not an exhaustive SRH catalogue.
Some SRH page titles contain German words or route suffixes; names were normalized conservatively while preserving official URL evidence.
Several records rely on programme-page admissions snippets and should be reviewed before production ingestion.

key_findings: SRH v0.3 zero-output was a crawler recall failure, not evidence of no programme data.
SRH v0.4 recovered 12 official programme URLs; v0.2 keeps them as a focused recall set while marking medium-confidence records for human review.
The Applied Artificial Intelligence bachelor and Supply Chain Management master have strong official admissions snippets with concrete English-test or document/ECTS requirements.
Shared SRH application process text is modeled as admissions interview/application workflow, not as programme-specific academic prerequisites.
